meta.title: Three wrong codes void the code; the right code is then refused
meta.requirement: AC5 — 3 wrong tries void the code
precondition: Reset code screen open with a code requested
steps: Enter a wrong 6-digit code with a valid new password, submit — three times
Enter the RIGHT code and submit
expected: Wrong tries 1 and 2: 'That code isn't right.' — UI tree
After the third wrong try the message is 'Too many wrong tries. Send a new code.' (on the 3rd or on the next submit) — UI tree + screenshot
The right code is refused: no password_reset_done event, still on auth.reset — event log + UI tree

1.observed: messages: ["That code isn't right.", "That code isn't right.", 'Too many wrong tries. Send a new code.']

2.observed: third: 'Too many wrong tries. Send a new code.'; after right code: 'Too many wrong tries. Send a new code.'
